about_the_game:
A GALAXY IN CHAOS. MULTIPLE WORLDS TO CLEAN UP.

Something has gone wrong in several corners of the galaxy, and Noah — a Slotharian operative equipped with cutting-edge technology — has been hired to fix the mess. Armed with futuristic tools and his ability to manipulate space-time, you’ll explore vibrant worlds filled with danger, puzzles, and secrets.

MULTIPLE EPISODES. CONNECTED ADVENTURES.

Each episode takes you to a completely different world with its own identity, enemies, and challenges. From natural planets overrun by toxic creatures to chaotic environments filled with rogue technology, every location presents new ways to face the chaos.

YOUR ARSENAL GROWS WITH EVERY MISSION

Noah wields a constantly expanding arsenal of futuristic gadgets. Capture enemies, manipulate the environment, clean up disasters, and solve impossible situations by combining your tools in unexpected ways. From traps and field devices to your special ability to slow down time, every tool opens up new possibilities.

EXPLORE, SOLVE, ADVANCE

Worlds full of secret areas, collectibles, and alternate routes. Run, jump, and glide with your jetpack as you explore every corner. Creative puzzles that force you to think differently. Unique challenges in every location — from epic encounters to thrilling escape sequences.

MODERN CARTOON VISUAL STYLE

Developed in Unreal Engine 5 with a colorful and expressive aesthetic. Each world has its own visual identity, from lush natural settings to urban and technological environments.

LIGHT-HEARTED TONE, ABSURD SITUATIONS

Noah may be lazy, but his wit makes him the most unlikely hero in the galaxy. Dynamic dialogues with his boss Vex keep the tone humorous as you face increasingly chaotic situations.

FEATURES

  • Multiple unique episodes with their own identity

  • Ever-expanding arsenal of futuristic gadgets

  • Time manipulation as a core mechanic

  • Vibrant cartoon-style worlds made in UE5

  • Smooth and precise 3D platforming

  • Absurd humor and unexpected situations

READY TO SAVE THE GALAXY?
